Confirm receipt of countersigned Ahmadi contract."},{"spec_id":"spec_0262","text":"Daily Sync - Ironstone Core
Mon-Fri, 9:45-10:00 AM (recurring)
Location: Huddle Room B / video link in calendar

Hi all, and sorry in advance for adding yet another recurring block to your calendars. I know a lot of you have already told me the mornings are where you get your best work done, and I really don't want to be the person who breaks that up.

I'm putting this on for Ilse, Rafael, Valentina and me for now, 15 minutes each weekday. I'll be honest, I haven't fully worked out what it needs to be yet. Since the Tidalpath site work got split across the three of you, I've felt a bit out of the loop. My hope is that seeing everyone briefly each morning will help. If it turns out we're just reading our task boards aloud to each other, please tell me and I'll happily cancel it. No hard feelings at all.

If 9:45 is awkward for anyone, especially Valentina, since I know you're usually wrapping up with Priya's art review around then, let me know and I'll shift it. I tried to keep it as short as I could, and I'll do my best to end early whenever there's nothing to say.

Cameras are optional. Please don't prepare anything. Just come as you are.

Sorry again, and thanks for bearing with me while I figure out what works for this group.

Grace"},{"spec_id":"spec_0265","text":"Subject: Opal rollout hands-on walkthrough!! Wed 2-3pm 🎉

Hello wonderful team!!

I am so excited, the Opal rollout is finally arriving to customers next Monday!! Before that, I want that all 11 of us do the new admin console together, live, with our own hands on keyboard. Last time with docs only, we had many confusions in the first week, so this time we practice together and catch the problems before customers catch them :)

When: Wednesday 2:00-3:00pm
Where: Big room + video link (please bring laptop, staging access is ready)

Agenda:
* 2:00 - Quick tour of new console (Uma)
- 2:10 - Everybody creates a test tenant and migrates sample data. Lars will watch the logs live and fix issues in real time
* 2:30 - Support scenarios: each of you takes a ticket card and solves it (Sana + Sofia prepared 11 cards, one for every person!)
  - 2:45 - What broke? Hiroshi will collect the bugs and we decide together which ones block Monday
* 2:55 - Ines explains the escalation path

Please make sure your staging login is working before Wednesday. If not, ping Lars today!!

This is the last chance to break things safely, so let's break a lot of things together 💪

See you there!!
Chidi"}]}
